literal: love / those without / all / to themselves / they are owners / love / those who possess / bone even / they are owners / to others
translation: Those without love claim everything for themselves. Those with love offer even their own bones to others.
modern: அன்பு இல்லாதவர்கள் எல்லாப் பொருள்களையும் தமக்கே உரியதாகக் கொள்வார்கள். ஆனால் அன்பு உடையவர்கள் தம் உடம்பிலுள்ள எலும்பையும் பிறருக்கு உரியதாக்குவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet contrasts the selfish nature of the loveless with the boundless generosity of the loving. Those who lack love claim everything for themselves, driven entirely by self-interest. In contrast, those who possess love are so selfless that they consider even their own 'bones'—representing their very body and life—as belonging to others. The word 'என்பு' (bone) powerfully symbolizes the ultimate sacrifice one can make out of love.
